request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and gentle, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft strings, hopeful and serene, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When Job prayed for his friends he stood
The Lord restored his fortunes to his hand
He gave him twice as much as before
A new beginning after the war

[Verse]
His brothers and sisters came to his door
They ate in his house and felt the floor
They consoled him over the trouble he saw
Giving pieces of silver and gold rings to draw

[Chorus]
He named the first Jemimah
The second Keziah
And the third Keren-happuch
A beauty that is much

[Verse]
Nowhere in all the land were they found
Women as beautiful without a sound
In Job's daughters the light did break
With an inheritance for their sake

[Chorus]
He named the first Jemimah
The second Keziah
And the third Keren-happuch
A beauty that is much

[Bridge]
They received an inheritance among their brothers
A gift of justice and gentle glories
The latter part of his life was blessed
More than the first and never less

[Chorus]
He named the first Jemimah
The second Keziah
And the third Keren-happuch
A beauty that is much

[Outro]
He saw his children to the fourth generation
And died old and full of days
